DRAFT FOR REVIEW

CONFIDENTIAL CASE BRIEF FOR LEGAL REVIEW

From: [SENDER NAME AND ADDRESS]
To: [RECIPIENT NAME AND ADDRESS]

Subject: Wrongful termination and workplace harassment (employment)

MATERIAL FACTS

1. Arjun Das, 31, worked for four years as a senior sales manager at a logistics software company, with consistently positive reviews and a "top performer" award two years ago. Eight months ago, a new regional director, Vikram Sethi, took over and began making comments about Arjun's "age and slow adaptation," excluding him from meetings, and reassigning his key accounts to a junior colleague. Arjun raised the issue verbally with HR twice and then sent a formal written complaint on 3 March, alleging discriminatory treatment and a hostile environment.

2. Eleven days later, he was placed on a "performance improvement plan" with targets that Arjun says were unachievable after losing his accounts. On 2 May, he was terminated by email for "poor performance and failure to meet PIP objectives," with one month's salary in lieu of notice and a request to sign a settlement agreement waiving all claims within seven days. Arjun believes the termination was retaliation for his complaint, and he is also unsure whether to sign the settlement, whether his unvested stock options are lost, and whether the "age" comments qualify as discrimination.

OUTCOME SOUGHT AND QUESTIONS FOR COUNSEL

[Specify the requested action or relief]

ENCLOSURES

None
